name: T&S Communications Co.,Ltd.
summary: T&S Communications Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells fiber optics communication products in China and internationally. The company offers active optical cables (AOC) and direct attach cables (DAC); fiber optic transceivers; MTP/MPO cable assemblies; Patch Cords and Pigtails; as well as shuffle and other cable assemblies. It also provides VSFF and Next-Gen Multi-Fiber Interconnects, such as MDC, CS, SN patchcords, and MXC, SN-MT, MMC cables; panel and enclosures; adapter and attenuator; and subcomponents, including ceramic ferrule, stub fiber ferrule, TOSA/ROSA receptacle, MT ferrule, MPO connector kits, PLC splitter wafer and chips.
